title: My neighbor left ONE grape on my doorstep for 41 days 🍇
tiktok_caption: Gary has been planning this for 6 weeks 🍇
description: Day 42 changed everything. Follow for day 43.

segments.text: My neighbor has been leaving one single grape on my doorstep every morning for forty one days.
At first I thought it was an accident. Then it was a pattern. Then it was a threat.
On day twelve, I set up a camera.
The footage shows my neighbor Gary, sixty three years old, walking over at five a.m. in a full tuxedo.
He places the grape. He bows. He leaves.
On day thirty, I finally confronted him. I said, Gary, what is this?
He looked me dead in the eyes and said, you will understand on day forty two.
So today was day forty two. I opened the door.
Just Gary. In the tuxedo. Holding a bottle of wine.
He said, every night I took the grape back. You never ate a single one. So I made wine.
This man has been fermenting my rejection for six weeks.
We drank it. It was honestly incredible. Follow for day forty three.
